# Morning

Wednesday, 25 November 2026 · No. 1

## Design & craft

### [The quiet structure behind interfaces that feel inevitable](<https://example.test/1>)

Quiet Systems · 1 min

![](<http://localhost/figma/read/lead-light.svg>)

Good products rarely announce their structure. They make the next move obvious, and that takes more editing than invention.

### [Why the best local-first apps still ship a server](<https://example.test/2>)

Small Tools Journal · 1 min

![](<http://localhost/figma/read/lines-light.png>)

A file you own is the start, not the end. Sync, backups and sharing still need somewhere to live.

### [Figma’s variables panel, a month in](<https://example.test/3>)

Interface Letters · 1 min

![](<http://localhost/figma/read/variables-light.svg>)

Modes finally feel like a first-class idea. Aliasing across collections is still the sharp edge.

### [A field guide to calm notification design](<https://example.test/4>)

Paperwork · 1 min

![](<http://localhost/figma/read/notifications-light.svg>)

Interruptions should earn their place. Most of them can wait for the next Brew.

## From your newsletters

### [Forms should declare their tools](<http://localhost/a/1>)

Interface Letters · 1 min

If an agent can fill your checkout, it shouldn’t have to guess what each field means. A short case for declaring intent in markup.

### [The consent prompt is the product](<http://localhost/a/2>)

Low Tide · 1 min

Every agent API meets the same question: who said yes? How browsers are designing the permission moment.

### [Twelve links, one long read](<http://localhost/a/3>)

Field Notes Weekly · 1 min

Paper prototypes, an ode to the status bar, and a long interview on designing for slowness.

### [Pricing pages are getting quieter](<http://localhost/a/4>)

The Margin · 1 min

Fewer tiers, more honest defaults. Forty pricing pages from this year, three patterns.

## Engineering

### [SQLite in the browser is finally boring](<https://example.test/9>)

Northwind Dispatch · 1 min

### [Cron, queues and the 10 ms budget](<https://example.test/10>)

The Platform Desk · 1 min

### [Shipping one codebase to five runtimes](<https://example.test/11>)

Small Tools Journal · 1 min

### [What we learned rewriting our feed parser](<https://example.test/12>)

Afterglow · 1 min

### [Readable diffs for configuration files](<https://example.test/13>)

Paperwork · 1 min
